csv_project_name: AE Svc for Oreleans Drive STP Project
csv_scope_of_work: City of McHenry is soliciting Statement of Qualifications (SOQ) from qualified firms for Architectural and/or Engineering services associated with the OAK/INDUSTRIAL/ORLEANS DRIVE STP PROJECT. The selected firm will be responsible for the Phase I - Preliminary Engineering and Phase II Design Engineering. The scope of the improvements will include: Grinding and resurfacing, curb and gutter repair, ADA ramp construction, pavement markings and other ancillary improvements for 1.27 miles of the Oak Drive, Industrial Drive, Orleans Drive Federal-aid Urban route from Route 120 to McCullom Lake Road in accordance with Illinois Department of Transportation (IDOT) and Surface Transportation Program (STP) standards.
